correctness.rationale: The selected K_n-edge subgraph totally dominates its line graph iff it has at most one isolated K_n vertex and no isolated K2 component. With k edges, c nontrivial components, eps isolates, and cycle rank s, n-eps=k+c-s and c<=floor(k/2). For k=ceil(2(n-1)/3), the residue-class equalities force forests of P3 blocks, optionally a P4/P5 or two P4 blocks; the proposed structural list exhausts possibilities (including n=4,5,6). Labeled partitions multiplied by Cayley tree counts 3,16,125 give all formulas. Independent direct open-neighborhood enumeration reproduced 12,80,840,630,13440 for n=4..8, including the two n=6 forest types. Finite enumeration is corroboration, the vertex-count/acyclicity argument is the all-n proof.

The mod-3 forest dichotomy/trichotomy is a complete classification for an infinite graph family, not a sample count.
